notes: Browser performance times come from actual event handlers and requestAnimationFrame after render. Only ordered click/API/render triples with matching API/render revision are included.
CUA roundtrip includes supported tool action, visible-result wait and DOM read inside the CUA call. It excludes idle time and orchestration/model time between tool calls.
Neither metric proves external Fantrax ingestion latency. No continuously running Fantrax watcher exists.
